$comment: An entry here SUPPRESSES a finding in the blocking audit. That is a decision with an owner and
an expiry, not a mute button: scripts/check_security_exceptions.py fails CI when an entry is
past its 'expires' date, so an exception cannot be forgotten into permanence. Extending one is
a reviewable commit that says who re-accepted the risk and until when.
Empty is the correct state. Every AI profile audits clean as of 2026-09-05; entries should be
rare and short-lived. Add one only when the finding cannot be fixed by an upgrade.
id            advisory identifier — GHSA-*, CVE-*, PYSEC-*, RUSTSEC-* or a Trivy id
component     the package the advisory is against, with the version in use
reachable     true if OUR code can reach the vulnerable path; false with justification in
'reason'. Never guess — if unknown, say so and treat it as reachable.
reason        why this is being accepted rather than fixed
control       the compensating control that makes the residual risk acceptable
owner         GitHub handle accountable for retiring it
expires       ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). CI fails from this date onward.
issue         URL of the follow-up issue tracking the real fix
